description_en: Creates virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border to protect mutual access traffic between network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) and a specified VPC. You do not need to create a VPC specifically for this
description_zh: 创建VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-vpc-firewall-cen-configure --vpc-firewall-name vpc-firewall-test --network-instance-id vpc-bp10zlifxh6j0232w0000 --vpc-region cn-hangzhou --firewall-switch open --cen-id cen-x5jayxou71ad730000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVpcFirewallCenConfigure

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The instance name of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance for which you want to create virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border.

Prerequisite: The VPC must be added to the CEN specified by the CenId parameter by invoking the AttachCenChildInstance operation
parameters.help_zh:
创建VPC边界防火墙的VPC实例ID。

前置依赖：该 VPC 必须已通过 Cbn.AttachCenChildInstance 接口加入到上述 CenId 指定的云企业网中
parameters.name: network_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC for which you want to create virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border.

For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建VPC边界防火墙的VPC所属地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: vpc_region

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the switch status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border. Valid values:

open (default): Automatically enables protection after you create a VPC and the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border are created.
close: Does not automatically enable protection after the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border are created. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345780.html operation to enable protection
parameters.help_zh:
设置VPC边界防火墙的开关状态。取值：

open（默认）：创建VPC边界防火墙后自动开启防护。
close：创建VPC边界防火墙后不自动开启防护。您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345780.html开启防护
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the CEN.

Prerequisite: The CEN instance must be created by invoking the CreateCen operation
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例ID。

前置依赖：该 CEN 实例必须已通过 Cbn.CreateCen 接口预先创建
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member accounts of the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the Cloud Firewall interface belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定云防火墙接口所属的vSwitch ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC CIDR block used by the firewall. You must configure a CIDR block with a subnet mask of no more than 28 bits to allocate to the VPC CIDR block required for the procedure of creating the firewall, in order to perform automatic creation of the firewall secure VPC (Cloud_Firewall_VPC) for traffic diversion and processing.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default is to automatically allocate the 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR block.

This parameter takes effect only when you create a VPC firewall in the local region of the CEN for the first time
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所使用VPC网段, 需配置子网掩码不大于28位网段来分配给创建防火墙过程所需VPC网段，用以自动创建防火墙安全VPC（Cloud_Firewall_VPC）进行流量引流处理。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配网段10.0.0.0/8。

参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary zone to which the firewall belongs.
If your business is sensitive to latency, you can set the zone of the firewall to be the same as the zone of the vSwitch in your business VPC to reduce latency.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns a zone for the firewall.



This parameter takes effect only when you create a VPC firewall in the local region of the CEN for the first time
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所属的主可用区ID。
如果您的业务延时敏感，您可以自定义防火墙可用区和业务VPC交换机可用区相同，以便降低延时。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配防火墙可用区。



参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch CIDR block used by the firewall. You must configure a CIDR block with a subnet mask of no more than 29 bits that does not conflict with your network planning to allocate to the vSwitch CIDR block required for the procedure of creating the firewall, in order to perform automatic creation of the vSwitch (Cloud_Firewall_VSWITCH) in the firewall secure VPC for traffic diversion and processing. The vSwitch CIDR block must be a subnet of the firewall VPC CIDR block.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default is to automatically allocate the 10.219.219.216/29 CIDR block.

This parameter takes effect only when you create a VPC firewall in the local region of the CEN for the first time
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所使用vSwitch网段, 需配置子网掩码不大于29位且不与网络规划冲突的网段来分配给创建防火墙过程所需vSwitch网段，用以自动创建防火墙安全VPC内的交换机（Cloud_Firewall_VSWITCH）进行流量引流处理。交换机网段必须是防火墙VPC网段的子网。

如果不填此参数, 则默认自动分配网段10.219.219.216/29。

参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vswitch_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone to which the firewall belongs. Only when the primary zone service is not active, the firewall will perform automatic switchover to the secondary zone to continue running.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default is to automatically allocate the secondary zone for the firewall.



This parameter takes effect only when you create a VPC firewall in the local region of the CEN for the first time
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所属的备可用区ID。只有防火墙主可用区服务不可用时, 防火墙会自动切换到备可用区继续运行。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配防火墙备可用区。



参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone to which the firewall vSwitch belongs
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙交换机所属的可用区 ID
parameters.name: firewall_vswitch_zone_id

VpcFirewallId.description_en: The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border
